## LmdbTransaction.isAborted property

Whether the user explicitly called [LmdbTransaction.abort()](./lmdb.lmdbtransaction.abort.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get isAborted(): boolean;
```

## Remarks

Read by [LmdbEnv.transaction()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.transaction.md) after the user's callback returns — if true, the LMDB childTransaction callback returns the `ABORT` sentinel.
